title: olvar telemetry v1
description: Payload published by the ESP32 to MQTT topic olvar/v1/<device_id>/telemetry (QoS 1, not retained). UTF-8 JSON object of at most 1024 bytes; NaN and Infinity are never sent. Unknown keys are allowed and ignored by the gateway. The gateway additionally requires device_id to equal the topic segment, rejects the reserved id 'olvar-gateway', and stores out-of-range sensor values as null (temperature_c -40..125, humidity_pct 0..100, lux 0..120000, soil_raw 0..4095, rssi_dbm -120..0).

device_id.description: Default "olvar-" + last 6 hex chars of the MAC, lowercase. Equals the MQTT username and client id.

boot_id.description: 8 random lowercase hex characters, generated once per ESP32 boot.

seq.description: Restarts at 0 on each boot. (device_id, boot_id, seq) is the dedup key.

temperature_c.description: Degrees Celsius; null when the read failed.

humidity_pct.description: Relative humidity in percent; null when the read failed.

lux.description: Illuminance in lux; null when the read failed.

soil_raw.description: Averaged 12-bit ADC count (0..4095); higher means drier. null on failure. There is no soil_pct: it is computed server-side from the device calibration.
